custom_role.description: Custom role for Act Security to scan Azure resources

permission_groups.label: Access map
permission_groups.description: Puts Reader's `*/read` in the custom role, so Act reads every resource through one role.

permission_groups.label: Kubernetes inside AKS clusters
permission_groups.description: Lets Act fetch the user kubeconfig of AKS clusters and read the Kubernetes objects inside them.

permission_groups.label: Activity logs
permission_groups.description: Streams the activity log of every subscription in scope to Act's Event Hub, which Act reads as Azure Event Hubs Data Receiver.

permission_groups.label: Entra ID logs
permission_groups.description: Streams the tenant's Entra ID audit and sign-in logs to Act's Event Hub.
